entries.original: Added `/claude-api api-version` to move Claude API code to API version `2026-10-21`
entries.translated: 서버가 재사용된 연결을 종료했을 때 Artifact 도구 읽기가 연결 재설정(connection reset)으로 실패하던 문제를 수정했습니다.

entries.original: Added the `claude_code.safety_event` OpenTelemetry event for each tool call a permission rule, auto mode, a safety check, a hook or the sandbox stopped, prompted or sent back
entries.translated: 셀프 호스트 러너: `--use-anthropic-git-proxy`를 사용하는 세션에서 이전 세션이 클론(clone)에 남겨둔 `.claude/settings.local.json` 파일을 커밋하던 문제를 수정했습니다.

entries.original: Fixed requests failing with a model-not-found error when `CLAUDE_CODE_DISABLE_1M_CONTEXT` is set and the model is an alias with the `[1m]` suffix, such as `opus[1m]`
entries.translated: 셀프 호스트 러너: checkout hook 실행 중에 세션을 아카이브하거나 다시 대기열에 추가할 때, 또는 러너를 중지할 때 훅 프로세스가 계속 실행되고 러너 슬롯이 점유된 상태로 남던 문제를 수정했습니다.

entries.original: Fixed the `prompt-caching-scope` beta header being sent behind custom `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` gateways and on Foundry, where it has no effect
entries.translated: 파싱할 수 없는 도구 호출에 대한 복구 기능 개선: Claude Code가 오류로 턴(turn)을 종료하기 전에 해당 호출을 최대 2회까지 재시도합니다.

entries.original: Fixed MCP servers showing "needs authentication" in `claude -p` on macOS while the login keychain was locked; they now say why, and the next run after an unlock connects without a new sign-in
entries.translated: 함께 실행되는 포크(fork) 서브 에이전트 개선: 각 에이전트가 자신의 실행(launch) 정보를 인식하게 되어, 포크된 에이전트들이 서로의 작업을 중복해서 시작할 가능성이 크게 줄었습니다.

entries.original: Fixed MCP servers being reported as timed out, and staying failed in headless runs, when a macOS or Linux computer went to sleep while they were connecting
entries.translated: 브라우저 로그인 개선: 계정 프로필이 로드될 때까지 기다리지 않고 로그인이 완료되는 즉시 성공 페이지가 표시됩니다.

entries.original: Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried
entries.translated: Fixed HTTP MCP tool calls being sent twice when the connection closed mid-call; only read-only or idempotent tools are now retried

entries.original: Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running
entries.translated: Fixed a turn sometimes starting without an SDK MCP server's latest tools when a background task was running

entries.original: Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results
entries.translated: Fixed some "Autocompact is thrashing" errors in turns that read many PDF pages, images or other large tool results

entries.original: Fixed `/autocompact` in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted
entries.translated: Fixed `/autocompact` in cloud sessions going back to the default window after the session restarted

entries.original: Fixed a conversation cleared with `/clear` sometimes coming back when a cloud or self-hosted runner session restarted
entries.translated: Fixed a conversation cleared with `/clear` sometimes coming back when a cloud or self-hosted runner session restarted

entries.original: Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` being ignored in Claude apps gateway sessions
entries.translated: Fixed `CLAUDE_STREAM_FIRST_BYTE_TIMEOUT_MS` being ignored in Claude apps gateway sessions

entries.original: Fixed telemetry from Claude Desktop sessions behind a Claude apps gateway being rejected when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` is set
entries.translated: Fixed telemetry from Claude Desktop sessions behind a Claude apps gateway being rejected when `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` is set

entries.original: Fixed `/permissions` > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command, and auto mode's local classifier ignoring an approval from there when it checks a retried command; approving a row now names the command, not its description
entries.translated: Fixed `/permissions` > Recently denied not showing the denied shell command, and auto mode's local classifier ignoring an approval from there when it checks a retried command; approving a row now names the command, not its description

entries.original: Fixed `/help` and the `/` command menu showing long model-facing descriptions for bundled skills such as `/claude-api` instead of their short descriptions
entries.translated: Fixed `/help` and the `/` command menu showing long model-facing descriptions for bundled skills such as `/claude-api` instead of their short descriptions

entries.original: Fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage and an empty stop reason for streamed responses
entries.translated: Fixed subagent transcripts recording placeholder token usage and an empty stop reason for streamed responses

entries.original: Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds
entries.translated: Fixed model switches through the Agent SDK's `setModel()`, and apps built on it, being refused when the API took more than 5 seconds to confirm the model; Claude Code now waits up to 15 seconds

entries.original: Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file
entries.translated: Fixed a background command stopped through a connected app (such as the desktop app archiving an idle session) being reported to Claude as stopped by the user; the notice now names its output file

entries.original: Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions
entries.translated: Fixed WebFetch in Cowork cloud sessions reporting a tool error when a site answered with a 4xx status or a robots.txt refusal; it is now a normal result, as in local sessions

entries.original: Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab
entries.translated: Fixed write tools on a directly configured GitHub MCP server showing a form that closed without creating anything in the desktop app's Code tab

entries.original: Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection
entries.translated: Fixed Artifact tool reads failing with a connection reset when the server had closed a reused connection

entries.original: Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session
entries.translated: Self-hosted runner: Fixed sessions with `--use-anthropic-git-proxy` committing a `.claude/settings.local.json` left in the clone by an earlier session

entries.original: Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held
entries.translated: Self-hosted runner: Fixed archiving or requeueing a session, or stopping the runner, during its checkout hook leaving the hook's processes running and the runner's slot held

entries.original: Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error
entries.translated: Improved recovery from unparseable tool calls: Claude Code now retries the call up to twice before ending the turn with an error

entries.original: Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work
entries.translated: Improved fork subagents launched together: each is now told which launch is its own, so forks are much less likely to try to start each other's work

entries.original: Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load
entries.translated: Improved browser sign-in: the success page now appears as soon as sign-in completes, without waiting for your account profile to load

entries.original: Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authentication error"
entries.translated: Improved web search errors in cloud and self-hosted runner sessions: a search refused with a 403 that gives a reason now shows that reason instead of a generic "Authentication error"

entries.original: Improved the time to the first reply in cloud sessions when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect
entries.translated: Improved the time to the first reply in cloud sessions when one of the desktop app's MCP servers can't connect

entries.original: Improved Remote Control connect time for sessions whose transcript contains large pasted images or PDF reads
entries.translated: Improved Remote Control connect time for sessions whose transcript contains large pasted images or PDF reads

entries.original: Changed the notice Claude gets when the WebSearch budget is used up to also tell it not to query search engines in a browser or through computer use
entries.translated: Changed the notice Claude gets when the WebSearch budget is used up to also tell it not to query search engines in a browser or through computer use

entries.original: Changed the `axScreenReader` setting and `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` in a settings `env` block to apply only from user, managed or `--settings` settings (since 2.1.305)
entries.translated: Changed the `axScreenReader` setting and `CLAUDE_AX_SCREEN_READER` in a settings `env` block to apply only from user, managed or `--settings` settings (since 2.1.305)

entries.original: Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0`
entries.translated: Self-hosted runner: Changed checkout hooks to be stopped after 30 minutes by default, failing the session's setup; if yours needs longer, raise `--checkout-hook-timeout-min` or set it to `0`

entries.original: Self-hosted runner: Changed the certificate file built for Anthropic-managed git to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does; a `[runner:warn]` line gives the number left out
entries.translated: Self-hosted runner: Changed the certificate file built for Anthropic-managed git to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does; a `[runner:warn]` line gives the number left out

entries.original: [VSCode] Added a notice on the microphone button when voice dictation stops by itself (15 seconds without recognized speech, or the 2-minute limit), saying why and that the text so far is kept
entries.translated: [VSCode] Added a notice on the microphone button when voice dictation stops by itself (15 seconds without recognized speech, or the 2-minute limit), saying why and that the text so far is kept

entries.original: [VSCode] Fixed a long prompt expanded with Show more covering the whole chat panel: a pinned prompt is now capped at 40% of the panel and scrolls
entries.translated: [VSCode] Fixed a long prompt expanded with Show more covering the whole chat panel: a pinned prompt is now capped at 40% of the panel and scrolls

entries.original: [VSCode] Fixed part of a list item or table cell with LaTeX math pasting as a new list or table in rich text editors
entries.translated: [VSCode] Fixed part of a list item or table cell with LaTeX math pasting as a new list or table in rich text editors

entries.original: [VSCode] Fixed dictation failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy when `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` is set only in `~/.claude/settings.json`; it now also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`
entries.translated: [VSCode] Fixed dictation failing behind a TLS-inspecting proxy when `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` is set only in `~/.claude/settings.json`; it now also follows `CLAUDE_CODE_CERT_STORE`

entries.original: [VSCode] Changed the "still open somewhere else" notice to also cover a Claude process left over from an extension restart, which usually ends on its own within about 10 minutes
entries.translated: [VSCode] Changed the "still open somewhere else" notice to also cover a Claude process left over from an extension restart, which usually ends on its own within about 10 minutes

entries.original: [VSCode] Changed voice dictation to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does
entries.translated: [VSCode] Changed voice dictation to filter its trusted certificates as the CLI does

entries.original: [VSCode] Changed the extension's own requests to filter their trusted certificates as the CLI does, and to trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file named in the environment or in user settings
entries.translated: [VSCode] Changed the extension's own requests to filter their trusted certificates as the CLI does, and to trust the `NODE_EXTRA_CA_CERTS` file named in the environment or in user settings

entries.original: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the repository picker saying "No repositories match" while a search was still running; it now shows "Searching…" until the results arrive
entries.translated: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the repository picker saying "No repositories match" while a search was still running; it now shows "Searching…" until the results arrive

entries.original: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the "Waiting for a runner" status on self-hosted environments being cut off; with on-demand runners it now counts up from your last message and shows failed attempts
entries.translated: [Cloud sessions] Fixed the "Waiting for a runner" status on self-hosted environments being cut off; with on-demand runners it now counts up from your last message and shows failed attempts

entries.original: [Code Review] Added `@claude review stop` (also `off` and `pause`) to Code Review, ending an `@claude review always` subscription on a pull request without starting a new review
entries.translated: [Code Review] Added `@claude review stop` (also `off` and `pause`) to Code Review, ending an `@claude review always` subscription on a pull request without starting a new review
